children: Soitec Trading Update
Bernin (Grenoble), France, September 2nd, 2026 -

Soitec (Euronext Paris), a world leader in the design and manufacturing of innovative semiconductor materials, today updated its Q2’27 revenue guidance and its outlook for Photonics-SOI revenue due to accelerating demand for Photonics-SOI, greater visibility on near-term customer requirements, and the Group’s ability to adjust capacity to meet that demand.

Q2’27 revenue is now expected to grow around 50% year-on-year, compared with Q2’26, at constant currency and scope, versus the more than 30% growth guidance provided in Soitec’s Q1’27 revenue press release on July 22nd, 2026.
Soitec now expects:
Photonics-SOI revenue in Q2’27 to be around 3 times the Q2’26 level of around $25m.
Photonics-SOI revenue in H1’27 to be around 2.3 times the H1’26 level of around $50m.
Photonics-SOI revenue in FY27 to be between 2.5 and 3 times the FY26 level of slightly above $100m.

As indicated in its Q1’27 revenue press release, Soitec continues to sign multi-year Capacity Reservation Agreements with multiple Photonics-SOI customers. The Group expects agreements to be in place with eight of around ten major Photonics-SOI customers in the coming weeks.
While Photonics-SOI activity accelerates, Soitec’s expectations for the rest of the business remain broadly unchanged.

About Soitec

Soitec (Euronext - Tech Leaders - SBF 120), a world leader in innovative semiconductor materials, has been developing cutting-edge products delivering both technological performance and energy efficiency for over 30 years. From its global headquarters in France, Soitec is expanding internationally with its unique solutions, and generated sales of around 600 million euros in fiscal year 2025-2026. Soitec occupies a key position in the semiconductor value chain, serving three main strategic markets: Mobile Communications, Automotive and Industrial, and Edge and Cloud AI. The company relies on the talent and diversity of nearly 2,000 employees, representing 50 different nationalities, working at its sites in Europe, the United States and Asia. Nearly 4,800 patents have been registered by Soitec.
